title: The Savior Kindly Calls
description: The Savior Kindly Calls in Tonic Solfa to AYLESBURY, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Henry Ustick Onderdonk wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 406.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to AYLESBURY; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: The Sa-vior kind-ly calls Our child-ren to His breast; He folds them in His gra-cious arms, Him-self de-clares them blest.

lines: He folds them in His gracious arms,
The heirs of heaven are such as these,
For such as these I came.”
With joy we bring them, Lord,
Imploring that, as we are Thine,

licence: Public domain: Henry Ustick Onderdonk died in 1858.
credits: Words by Henry Ustick Onderdonk (1789–1858), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to AYLESBURY by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
